members.role: the page lands BUILT: the whole history is the evidence, read before anything moves
ONE move lands on today: the axes retarget to the last stretch, today's datum at the plot's right edge (E59: a push lands on a named datum)
on the word that names the condition a '?' lands PAST the plot's right edge beside today's tip, clear of the end tags, and holds (BOOM 03:19)

does: The history lands whole, one rescale lands the view on today's datum at the plot's edge, and on the sentence that turns to what comes next a '?' lands past the edge beside the tip - the future named as a question, never drawn as a number.

use_when.act: COMPARES (projecting) / TURNS - today read against its history, then the open future (BRAVOS-USE-WHEN R5)

use_when.use: the camera or a rescale lands on today, then a '?' runs off the edge ('The flip: if memory breaks while the buildout holds...'); where the sources DO give a scenario, T16's labelled dashed path takes the '?''s place (recipe:evidence-then-the-conditional-future)
use_when.dont: a continuous push (E59); the lens as decoration; a drawn path the sources do not give (E77) - the '?' is the honest form; a '?' on a datum or over the end tags
